input: Show only outliers of total_bill, based on 1.5 * IQR. Ordered it by total_bill, descending.
target:
WITH quantiles AS (
  SELECT 
    quantile_cont(total_bill, 0.25) AS Q1, 
    quantile_cont(total_bill, 0.75) AS Q3
  FROM tips
),
limits AS (
  SELECT 
    Q1, 
    Q3, 
    (Q3 - Q1) AS IQR,
    Q1 - 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1) AS lower_fence,
    Q3 + 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1) AS upper_fence
  FROM quantiles
)
SELECT tips.*
FROM tips
CROSS JOIN limits
WHERE total_bill < limits.lower_fence
   OR total_bill > limits.upper_fence
ORDER BY total_bill DESC
